hackathons.title: Capture the flag 2026 – Campus edition
hackathons.eligibility: Open to campus students and cybersecurity enthusiasts
hackathons.summary: This Capture the Flag hackathon invites campus students to solve real-world cybersecurity challenges. Participants can showcase their skills and test their knowledge in a high-energy competitive environment.

hackathons.title: ByteMe CTF 26
hackathons.eligibility: Open to students and cybersecurity enthusiasts
hackathons.summary: ByteMe CTF 26 is a cybersecurity capture the flag competition organized by OWASP PCCoE. Hosted on the CTF7 platform, it challenges participants with hands-on security scenarios and workflows.

hackathons.title: Black Hat India 2026 Official CTF
hackathons.eligibility: Open to students and cybersecurity enthusiasts
hackathons.summary: The official Capture the Flag competition for Black Hat India 2026 hosted on CTF7. It allows participants and teams to compete across leaderboards in various cybersecurity challenges.

hackathons.title: 2027 WFEO Hackathon on Sustainable Transport Engineering
hackathons.eligibility: Engineering students and young engineers under 30
hackathons.summary: The 2027 WFEO Hackathon invites engineering students and young engineers to solve challenges focused on sustainable transport engineering. Participants work in multidisciplinary teams over a three-week online hackathon period.
